description: Amazon Best Sellers list for one category, as Amazon shows it now: up to 100 products in rank order (rank, ASIN, title, price, rating, ratings count), the category's full breadcrumb path, and its subcategories with their URLs. With only marketplace_id (no url) it returns the marketplace's top-level best-seller categories, so you can walk the tree: root -> category -> subcategory, always with a URL from a previous answer. Use when the user asks what sells best in a category right now or wants a top-100 list. For keyword searches use amazon_search_results or search_products. Fresh lists take 15-35 seconds; Amazon refreshes them hourly, so recent lists return instantly. Amazon marketplaces only.

marketplace_id.description: Without url: list this marketplace's top-level categories. 1=UK 2=US 4=CA 5=AU 6=DE 7=JP 8=IT 9=FR 10=ES 11=MX 12=BR.

url.description: An Amazon Best Sellers URL (a category, or one from a previous answer's subcategories / categories / path).
